newsitem.title: GERMANY: RESEARCH ALERT - Fresenius kept overweight.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fresenius kept overweight.

text.p: Research group Independent Research said on Wednesday they were holding their overweight recommendation on German medical group Fresenius AG and its dialysis subsidiary Fresenius Medical Care (FMC).
Analysts at Independent Research said in a research document that Fresenius stood on a more stable basis than FMC and said the subsidiary was "only interesting on a speculative basis."
Independent Research lifted its earnings per share (EPS) outlook for Fresenius, by the DVFA analysts' method, for 1997 to 9.20 marks from 9.09 marks.

Preference shares in Fresenius were up 20.50 marks, or 5.73 percent, at 378.50 marks in late bourse trade, while shares in FMC were also among the market leaders at 157.40 marks, up 7.70 marks or 5.14 percent.
The group said that the market had mostly priced in any growth at FMC until the year 2000.
